sources.title: Public data
sources.verified_claim: HMLR lists public and licensed land/property datasets and explicitly says reasonable skill and care is used but fitness for a particular purpose is not guaranteed. Dataset availability is not exact ownership proof.

sources.title: UK companies that own property in England and Wales dataset - Technical specification
sources.verified_claim: The monthly dataset covers registered freehold/leasehold titles legally owned by UK companies or corporate bodies, with defined inclusions/exclusions. Exact title matching is still required.

sources.title: UK companies that own property in England and Wales
sources.verified_claim: The dataset excludes private individuals, overseas companies and charities and can contain address/company-number inconsistencies. It cannot be used to infer candidate ownership without title/address matching.

sources.title: Overseas companies that own property in England and Wales
sources.verified_claim: The monthly dataset contains completed records of non-UK corporate owners but excludes private individuals, UK companies with overseas addresses and charities; records being updated are not shown until later releases.

sources.title: Overseas companies that own property in England and Wales dataset - Technical specification
sources.verified_claim: The specification defines proprietor types, tenure codes, update cadence and field limitations. Not every title has price-paid data and property schedules may contain additional addresses.

sources.title: Register of Overseas Entities
sources.publisher: Companies House / Department for Business and Trade / HM Land Registry
sources.verified_claim: Overseas entities dealing with relevant UK property must register and disclose registrable beneficial owners or managing officers. Register obligations do not prove that any sample parcel is overseas-owned.

sources.title: Register an overseas entity and its beneficial owners
sources.verified_claim: Current guidance explains registration, Overseas Entity IDs and removal where the entity is no longer a registered owner. Corporate-registry status must be cross-checked against the land title.

sources.title: Companies House annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_claim: Companies House reports 33,100 overseas entities on the Register as at 31 March 2026 and describes enforcement improvements. Registry-wide figures are context, not candidate ownership evidence.
